sourceCoordinate.basis: centre of retained source footprint bounds, Mercator metres; candidate matching documented separately

sources.ownershipMethod: Full source polygon first; otherwise a uniquely covering union of individual source convex hulls. Legacy roofplant shrinking about an interior point can leave concave footprint bounds; original geometry is preserved, not repaired. Vertex-connected components cannot cross groups. Independently regenerated byte-exact archived GLB and checked per-source triangle-signature multiplicity against every output.
limits: Only original indexed triangles, attributes, materials and shared terrain anchor are partitioned; no photo-completion credit.

All unrelated and withheld source buildings remain in original compound residuals. Registeredheight0/sourceheightnull remain missing; no measuredheight claim. Standalone residential assets remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Only independently verified source identities receive numbered fallback labels; every archived GLB remains unchanged.
Original concave-footprint convex-hull approximations are retained and explicitly counted.

sourceAuthoringReplay.rangeConvention: Half-open [start,end) original indexed triangle ranges, one range per material; original vertex packing retains emission order.
